answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to publish a chained, independently re-derivable record of payments it received from distinct counterparties. A newcomer starts with zero weight and must accumulate yarrow-thin links over many epochs; a grove of aliases that pays only itself collapses into one node under cycle-merging, while a karst of diverse, unrelated settlements keeps separate credit. Weight is thus bounded by real external trade rather than by keys.
